meta.title: The event's creator can place a surrogate bid
gaps: the case needs a caller who is not a super admin (or lacks a permission), and every run acts as the client's own super-admin buyer — a refusal it expects may legitimately not happen
warnings: a read-back was added in code: As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts the new bid.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer enters a bid on a vendor's behalf (surrogate bid).
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts the new bid.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: the round counts the new bid.
